summary: Lanes by ticket size and risk: the analyst sizes each ticket (S, M, L) and names its risk areas, and run_state.py intake turns them into the run's lane and settings. An S ticket is refined only when the analyst found gaps and gets two reviewers, one whole-suite run and at most 10 mutants; M at most 25 mutants; L every lens with one reviewer each. Any risk area raises a ticket to at least M; authentication, permissions or personal data to L. Both gates stay by default in every lane; lanes.S.gates set to ship only skips the plan gate on small tickets. The lane is shown at the gates and can be changed with --lane or 'adjust: lane X'; a configuration key that differs from its default still applies to every lane.
